name: MCAR23495
general_comments:
The transmission oil leaks should be repaired, and all faulty seals and gaskets must be replaced. The sump gasket also needs to be replaced to eliminate the existing leakage. The hydraulic suction pipe should be thoroughly inspected and replaced due to the identified kink, which may be restricting proper fluid flow. In addition, the oil leak at the injector loom entry point on the tappet cover must be repaired.

A complete service should be carried out, especially considering that there is no available service history for the machine. A diagnostic scan is required to identify and resolve the boom operation fault associated with intermittent error codes. Furthermore, the transmission fault, which is currently limiting operation to gears 1 and 2, must be investigated and rectified.

It is also necessary to obtain and review the machine’s service manual, along with the electrical and hydraulic schematics, to aid in proper troubleshooting. Finally, joint troubleshooting should be conducted with an electrician to effectively trace and resolve any electrical or control-related faults.
